scenes.text: The astronauts' footprints on the Moon could last millions of years.
Twelve people walked on the Moon between nineteen sixty nine and nineteen seventy two.
On Earth, wind and rain would erase a footprint in days.
But the Moon has almost no atmosphere, so there is no wind and no rain.
Only the slow wear from the Sun's particles, or a direct meteorite hit, can wipe them away.
If you could leave one thing on the Moon forever, what would it be?

title: Footprints on the Moon could last millions of years 👣
caption: With no wind or rain on the Moon, the Apollo astronauts' bootprints will likely stay for millions of years. Only a meteorite hit or very slow wear from solar particles can erase them. 🌕
